failures.name: clang-metadata-callback-output
steps: NFS callback output priority under TCP backpressure
NFS callback response deadline after delayed transmission
observations: Both invocations fail in tests/nfs_output_queue.py line 51 while setting up backpressure, before callback behavior assertions.
queued_bytes observes TCP state 04 (FIN_WAIT1), with 0xB0631 bytes queued. The log does not establish why the service closed the connection.
GCC and MSVC metadata jobs at this commit pass; this does not resolve the Clang failures.

limits: These failures precede the client-binding adoption changes.
Windows startup logs show invalid_configuration_or_io but do not establish which initialization operation failed.
Passing native Linux components does not resolve these failures or prove Full SMB/NFS conformance.
